senses.gloss: m. pl. (abstract noun, v. גֵּאֶה; cmp. חַיִים) loftiness, excellence; (in a bad sense) haughtiness.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 92a:5">Ḥull. 92ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ש̇ר̇י̇ג̇י̇ם̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 40:10">Gen. XL, 10</cite>) <he>שלשה ש̇ר̇י̇ ג̇</he>' <he>בכל וכ׳</he> the three princes of excellence (influential patrons of Israel) in every generation (in Palestine under the Roman, in Babylon under the Parthian government).—
Ber. 10ᵇ; Yalk. Lev. 616 (ref. to I Kings XIV, 9) א״ת גַּוֶּךָ אלא גֵּאֶיךָ read not gavvekha (thy body), but geekha, thy swelling or pride (applied to taking a meal before prayer), v. גָּאָה.
